snippet.title: Calmaria: Wild Growth | Cozy Co-op Survival & Building | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The demo is coming soon! Wishlist Calmaria: Wild Growth on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4683860/Calmaria_Wild_Growth/

Life on the island is peaceful. At least, that's what we're telling the family.

Calmaria: Wild Growth is a cozy survival crafting game about building your own island settlement, automating its daily work and discovering what's beyond the next shore. Play solo or bring your friends along in online co-op for up to 4 players.

Start with a handful of crops and a lot of carrying things yourself. Build workshops, welcome settlers and turn your harvests into supplies for a growing community. Connect production chains, unlock new technologies and put machines and drones to work. Less hauling, more time for your next big idea.

Then pack your gear and take the boat out. Explore a procedurally generated archipelago, venture into dungeons and face bosses for valuable loot. Bring your discoveries home, craft better equipment and prepare your settlement for the next wave of creatures. They like your crops too.

Our “A Letter Home” trailer shares a little of island life. Some details may have been left out to avoid worrying the family.

Come visit when the demo arrives. We've saved you a place.

Join our community on Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/hUZRBgcDa9

Explore the world of Calmaria:
https://calmariagame.com/

#Calmaria #SurvivalCrafting #Coop
